neighbours.label: A design change described as improving a vehicle's or craft's stability, control or clearance ('to improve yaw control', 'more stable', 'for improved ground clearance'), firing on 'improve(d)' or 'more'; design changes with other effects (weight, colour, cost) stay lower.
fire: Engineers lengthened the keel to improve the boat's stability.
The wider wheelbase makes the truck more stable in corners.
A rear spoiler was added for improved grip at high speed.
Lowering the seat makes the scooter easier to control.
Twin rudders improve steering in rough water.
The new suspension gives improved ground clearance on trails.
Winglets were fitted to improve roll control.
Heavier tyres keep the tractor more stable on slopes.
quiet: Engineers lengthened the keel to fit a larger cabin.
The wider wheelbase makes the truck harder to park.
A rear spoiler was added in a bright red finish.
Lowering the seat makes the scooter cheaper to build.
Twin rudders add weight to the stern.
The new suspension costs more than the old one.
Winglets were fitted during the last overhaul.
Heavier tyres make the tractor slower on roads.

notes: Card: peaks on ' improve' (fin ... to improve yaw control), ' more' (more stable), ' improved' (improved ground clearance), ' for' (important for aero); output suppresses ' stability', ' stable', ' aer', ' airflow'. Exploratory probe: 0.48-0.74 on those; 'painted bright red' 0.01; 'heavier on gravel' 0.27.
